title: Anker PowerCore 24K: Powering Your Devices in Kenya
excerpt: Discover the Anker PowerCore 24K 140W power bank, a high-capacity portable charger available in Kenya. This device keeps your laptops, phones, and tablets charged on the go with its impressive 24,000mAh capacity and fast 140W output.
content:
Introduction

In a world where our digital lives are constantly active, a dead battery can be a major inconvenience. Whether you're a student shuttling between lectures, a remote worker in a co-working space, or an avid traveler exploring Kenya, reliable portable power is essential. The Anker PowerCore 24K 140W power bank steps in as a robust solution, designed to keep your essential gadgets, from smartphones to power-hungry laptops, fully charged.

Anker has a long-standing reputation for quality and performance in power solutions, and the PowerCore 24K is no exception. This particular model combines a substantial 24,000mAh capacity with a powerful 140W output, making it one of the most capable power banks on the market. It’s built for those who demand serious power on the move, without being tied to a wall socket.

Key Specifications

Feature Specification
Ports 2 USB-C, 1 USB-A
Display Color Smart Digital Screen
Capacity 24,000 mAh
Output Power 140W Max (Total)
Compatibility Universal (Laptops, Phones, Switch, Tablets)
Recharge Speed 140W Input (PD 3.1 compatible)
Dimensions Approximately 16.2 x 5.7 x 4.9 cm
Weight Approximately 630g

Design & Build

The Anker PowerCore 24K 140W is a robust piece of hardware. It features a solid, slightly textured finish that feels good in hand and resists fingerprints. While it's not a pocket-sized device – its 24,000mAh capacity necessitates a certain bulk – its design is functional and well-executed. The rounded edges make it comfortable to carry, and it feels built to withstand the rigors of daily travel.

One standout design element is the color smart digital screen. This display provides real-time information on remaining battery percentage, as well as the input and output wattage for each connected port. This level of detail is genuinely useful, allowing you to monitor charging speeds and ensure your devices are receiving optimal power, which is a significant step up from simple LED indicators found on most power banks.

Performance

Performance is where the Anker PowerCore 24K truly shines. The 140W max output, delivered via Power Delivery 3.1 technology, means this power bank can fast-charge demanding devices like MacBook Pros, powerful Windows laptops, and even gaming handhelds. For reference, a 16-inch MacBook Pro (M1 Pro) can charge at its full 140W speed, making this a true laptop charger on the go.

With its 24,000mAh capacity, this power bank can typically recharge a modern smartphone multiple times, or provide a significant boost to a laptop, often giving it a full charge or more depending on the model. The inclusion of two USB-C ports and one USB-A port allows for simultaneous charging of up to three devices, which is incredibly convenient. Imagine charging your laptop, phone, and TWS earbuds all at once from a single portable source – ideal for busy schedules or power outages.

Recharging the PowerCore 24K itself is also remarkably fast. With a 140W input, it can go from empty to full in about 52 minutes when using a compatible 140W PD 3.1 wall charger. This rapid recharge capability minimizes downtime, ensuring your power bank is ready when you need it, which is a major benefit for frequent travelers or those with limited access to power outlets.

Verdict

The Anker PowerCore 24K 140W is an exceptional power bank designed for users with high power demands. Its combination of large capacity, rapid charging speeds (both output and input), and comprehensive digital display makes it a standout product. While it's a premium device with a price tag to match, the performance and convenience it offers justify the investment, especially for professionals, students, and travelers in Kenya who cannot afford to be without power.

If you regularly charge laptops, multiple smartphones, or other power-hungry gadgets away from a wall outlet, the Anker PowerCore 24K 140W is a highly recommended portable power solution. It provides the peace of mind that your essential devices will remain operational, no matter where your day takes you.
